damage_volume.method: Threshold POINTS with AllScalars=1; retain only existing dx/4 cells whose every vertex is at least.99; no geometric dilation

geometry: saved deformed particles at true scale; black .99 native quadratic B-spline field sampled in REFERENCE coordinates; no particle deletion

field_evaluation.method: stored exact nodal coefficients, quadratic tensor-product B-splines
field_evaluation.limitation: Contour is piecewise linear on fixed dx/4 samples; physical notch-straddling cells excluded independently of damage; reference contour is not a deformed crack surface
